title: Kitty 0.43.0 before 0.51.0 contains a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability that allows attackers to emit…
description: Kitty versions from 0.43.0 up to but not including 0.51.0 contain a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability. This flaw allows attackers to craft malicious file or archive member names that, when highlighted in the choose-files kitten preview panel, cause unsanitized escape sequences to be emitted. These sequences can overwrite the clipboard via OSC 52, create OSC 8 links, change the window title, or spoof the screen. The vulnerability requires user interaction (highlighting the malicious entry) and local access. The CVSS score is low (3.3), reflecting limited impact and attack complexity.
